instagram.caption:
The outfit she never wore.
The Baby Clothing Zone in the Nursery. Holds the sizes your baby fits this month and moves everything else out of the house fast.

What done looks like:
1. Each drawer holds one size only with the size written on the drawer front
2. Bodysuits filed upright so you read every collar from above
3. A next-size bin on the closet shelf
4. An outgoing bag on the door hook with something already in it

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success baby clothing zone.
